Nia Fitzgerald
nia.fitzgerald@example.com | Nashville, TN

Account Executive at Cartwheel Media (2024-2026), where they closed $3M in
annual recurring revenue across mid-market accounts at Cartwheel Media. Before
that, Account Executive at Palisade Partners (2021-2024). Before that, Sales
Development Rep at Sonora Creative (2019-2021). Education: B.A. Economics,
University of Cincinnati, 2018. Core skills: Account management, Salesforce,
Quota attainment, CRM tools, Cold outreach, Pipeline forecasting.
